call_points.text: FY26 value of area booked was a record ₹2,421.13 Cr, up 25.01% from ₹1,936.75 Cr in FY25.
Aaroham Phase 1 and 2 in Gurugram sold ₹832.50 Cr at launch, the main driver of FY26 bookings.
Senior Living bookings were the highest ever at ₹570.15 Cr (569 units) against ₹382.90 Cr (430 units) in FY25.
FY26 collections from customers were the highest ever at ₹1,762 Cr.
Equivalent Area Constructed rose 30.19% to 26.19 lakh sq ft in FY26 from 20.12 lakh sq ft in FY25.
Ongoing projects carry ₹5,897.31 Cr of booked sale value to be recognised over the next 3-5 years.
The company bought 8.83 acres at Wavarle, Raigad for a Senior Living project of about 4.50 lakh sq ft.
It also signed an agreement to sell for 6.02 acres and a perpetual lease for 1.03 acres at Panvel, with FSI potential of 7.05 lakh sq ft.
The Aaroham Gurugram project was funded by IFC through ₹100 Cr of listed unsecured redeemable NCDs.

timeline.summary: Ashiana Housing Limited’s EGM on April 22, 2026, approved Mr. Vikas Choudhury’s (DIN: 00267030) appointment as Independent Director with 70.03% shareholder votes in favor.
Ashiana Housing allotted ₹43.25 Cr of unsecured NCDs on private placement to Clover Technologies Private Limited.
Ashiana Housing filed annual promoter share encumbrance disclosures reporting zero encumbered shares for FY26.
Ashiana Housing reported operational performance for April 2026 with booked area of 0.85 lakh sq. ft. valued at ₹91.40 Cr.
On May 12, 2026, Ashiana Housing paid ₹34.28 Cr for interest and partial redemption of secured NCDs.

On 15 May 2026, Ashiana Housing said it and Mahindra World City (Jaipur) mutually terminated their 30 October 2024 agreement to lease about 20 acres in Jaipur for a group housing project, citing non-visibility of MWC's approvals.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹322.81 Cr, net profit ₹20.97 Cr.
Ashiana Housing's FY26 investor presentation reported record area bookings of ₹2,421.13 Cr (up 25.01%), record revenue of ₹1,185.06 Cr and record PAT of ₹117.89 Cr with ROE at 15.25%.
Nitin Sharma (Company Secretary & Compliance Officer) shared the link to the conference call recording on 29 May 2026 for Q4 FY2026 and FY2026 performance discussion.
On 1 June 2026, Ashiana Housing reported May 2026 area booked of 1.43 lakh sq ft worth ₹136.04 Cr, taking April–May to 2.28 lakh sq ft and ₹227.44 Cr.
Ashiana Housing filed the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings call held on May 29, 2026.
Ashiana Housing Limited will conduct a conference call for analysts and investors on 05th November 2026 from 04:00 PM to 05:00 PM IST.
Ashiana Housing received an upward credit rating revision to CARE A+; Stable from CARE Edge for its issuer rating and NCDs.
